title: Where does the sequence need each operation?
principle: The map composes relationships. The artifact realizes them. The prose attends to what happens.
scope: A proposal for this five-stop sequence, not permanent author assignments. The reference remains the comparison baseline; no candidate is adopted.
apparatus_note: The reviewed edition describes the earlier three-line RANDOM TOUCH. The current artifact is now a five-row abacus; its changed encounter needs another reading before the older findings can be extended to it.

entries.reading_change: Stay with touch, bounded motion and differences of speed before explaining generation.
entries.newly_perceptible: The same sideways targets can occupy different durations; another axis changes the space available to the virtual hand.
entries.relation: The opening supplies movement from numbers. Later movement supplies a number; later still an excursion carries the body and must return.
entries.risk: Prescribing a feeling, confusing virtual-hand displacement with bodily travel, or describing three lines after the apparatus has changed to five.
entries.can_remain_unspoken: The later inversion and the chapter's account of agency need not be announced here.

entries.reading_change: Give the held five-digit group time among the continuing rows.
entries.newly_perceptible: Selecting an existing result changes its persistence in view without changing its production.
entries.relation: The later persistent seed readout can recall the held group while naming a different kind of record.
entries.risk: Adding a second archival interpretation before the retained digits have acquired attention.
entries.can_remain_unspoken: A general philosophy of preservation; the Geiger can make the contrast available later.

entries.reading_change: Receipt, readout, sound and calculation arrive as distinct kinds of evidence, retaining the reference's concise audible repetition.
entries.newly_perceptible: A dated acquisition is not the same event as a repeating calculation or playback.
entries.relation: The held digits and persistent seed both remain amid passing events, but an outcome and a starting input are different records.
entries.risk: A labelled technical manual; presenting explanatory prose as a code excerpt; mistaking synthesized playback for an audio recording of radiation.
entries.can_remain_unspoken: The philosophical meaning of preservation; the next artifact's number/movement inversion.
entries.observed_effect: The supplied passage reading distinguishes receipt, readout, sound and calculation and explicitly recalls the held RAND digits. This supports a local relation, not a completed whole-chapter map test.

entries.reading_change: Let the gesture and resulting seed disclose the reversal when the encounter happens.
entries.newly_perceptible: Movement supplies an input where the opening supplied movement from numerical values; distinct gestures can share a seed.
entries.relation: A remembered opening changes direction here; the new seed can reach the hall's private instruments.
entries.risk: Announcing the reversal in the Geiger transition, or reporting an unperformed gesture-collision experiment as a result.
entries.can_remain_unspoken: The inversion until the gesture yields its number; the person's intention cannot be recovered from that seed.

entries.reading_change: Let the variable excursion meet its compulsory return, and finish at that constraint.
entries.newly_perceptible: Choosing another seed varies a journey within a rule that the choice does not remove.
entries.relation: Authored limits recall the opening; the compulsory return differs from voluntarily pressing RESTART.
entries.risk: A concluding moral or false equivalence between chosen replay and compulsory return.
entries.can_remain_unspoken: A summary of the chapter's theme or a claim about what every participant must feel.

pending_passage_edits.change: Replace the register heading 'In the program' with 'The calculation' when preparing the next candidate; the passage contains explanatory prose, not a literal code excerpt.
Keep explicit that the program renders sound from stored event times; it is not an audio recording of measured radiation.
Replace 'travelled' with wording about the visible hand following the sphere; the viewpoint remains fixed.
Remove the advance announcement of movement becoming a number. Let MOVE / KEEP realize the connection.

next_test: After the abacus revision is stable, check its situated opening, then compare a minimally corrected montage in the complete sequence. Ask which record supports which claim and what another encounter changes. Do not combine all three strategies by default.
